entries.heading: One seat on a regular 15-amp plug
entries.summary: Peak Shasta is a 1-person indoor infrared sauna in Canadian Hemlock, 42 × 40 × 75 inches outside, with a 120 V, 1,800 W plug-in supply.
paragraphs: Shasta is a single-seat infrared cabin for indoor use. Outside it takes up 42 × 40 inches of floor and stands 75 inches tall; inside you get 38 × 36 inches and 67 inches of height. If that is too big, Peak's Mini is 11 inches narrower and 8 inches lower.

Peak lists 1,800 watts at 120 volts and a standard three-prong NEMA 5-15P plug. That load uses all 15 amps of a 15-amp circuit, so nothing else should be running on it. Peak doesn't say whether the circuit has to be dedicated, but the math points that way.
decision_points: Same size and power as Peak's Rainier; Shasta is Hemlock, Rainier is red cedar.
At 305 pounds, think about stairs before you pick an upstairs room.
Check what else shares the outlet's breaker.
limitations: Peak doesn't publish a minimum clearance or package size for the Shasta.

entries.heading: Two seats and a 20-amp outlet
entries.summary: Peak Everest is a 2-person indoor infrared sauna, 53 × 44 × 75 inches in Canadian Hemlock, and needs a dedicated 120 V, 20 A circuit.
paragraphs: Two people sit in an infrared cabin that measures 53 × 44 inches on the floor and 75 inches high. The inside is 49 × 40 inches with 67 inches of height. Everest is 11 inches wider and 4 inches deeper than the one-person Shasta.

The 2,050-watt system runs on 120 volts through a NEMA 5-20P plug, and Peak asks for a dedicated 20-amp circuit. A 5-20P plug won't go into an ordinary 15-amp outlet. Unless you already have a free 20-amp outlet, plan on an electrician.
decision_points: Same cabin size and wattage as Fuji, with Hemlock in place of red cedar.
Needs a 20-amp outlet of its own.
If 53 inches is too wide, Crown also seats two at 48 inches and plugs into 15 amps.
limitations: Peak doesn't list shipping dimensions or wall clearances for the Everest.

entries.heading: Peak's smallest sauna, 67 inches tall
entries.summary: Peak Mini is a 1-person full-spectrum infrared sauna for indoors, only 31 × 32 × 67 inches, drawing 1,200 W from a 120 V plug-in supply.
paragraphs: Nothing else in Peak's range is as small as the Mini, which needs 31 × 32 inches of floor. It is a one-person, full-spectrum infrared cabin built from Canadian Hemlock. Standing 67 inches tall, it also goes under ceilings and soffits that rule out the 75-inch Shasta.

Power is the easy part. Peak rates it at 1,200 watts and 10 amps on 120 volts with a plug-in connection, the lowest draw of any Peak model we list. Which plug it uses and which circuit rating Peak wants are not stated, so ask before you buy.
decision_points: The shortest Peak cabin here, useful under a low ceiling.
10 amps leaves some room on a 15-amp circuit.
Interior size isn't given, so taller buyers should ask Peak for bench and headroom measurements.
limitations: Peak doesn't state the plug type, the required circuit or the interior dimensions of the Mini.

entries.heading: Two seats on a regular 15-amp plug
entries.summary: Peak Crown is a 2-person indoor infrared sauna, 48 × 44 × 79 inches in Canadian Hemlock, running on 120 V and 1,800 W with a NEMA 5-15P plug.
paragraphs: Crown is the narrowest two-seater from Peak on this site. The full-spectrum infrared cabin is 48 inches wide, 5 inches less than Everest or Fuji, and the same 44 inches deep. It makes up some of that in height, with 79 inches outside and 71 inches inside.

Unlike Peak's larger two-seaters, it runs on 1,800 watts and 15 amps through a standard NEMA 5-15P plug. That is the full capacity of a 15-amp circuit. Peak doesn't specify a circuit rating or say if it must be dedicated, so keep other devices off that breaker.
decision_points: The two-person Peak to look at first if you don't have a 20-amp outlet.
79 inches tall, so measure ceilings in basements.
Weighs 385 pounds.
limitations: Peak doesn't publish wall clearances or a required circuit for the Crown.

entries.heading: The red cedar version of Everest's size
entries.summary: Peak Fuji is a 2-person indoor infrared sauna in Canadian Red Cedar, 53 × 44 × 75 inches, with 2,050 W on a dedicated 120 V, 20 A circuit.
paragraphs: Fuji and Everest have identical measurements, 53 × 44 × 75 inches outside and 49 × 40 × 67 inches inside. The wood is the difference. Fuji is built in Canadian Red Cedar and has a full-spectrum infrared system.

Peak lists 2,050 watts and 20 amps at 120 volts, on a dedicated 20-amp circuit. The plug isn't named for this model, even though Everest with the same power uses a NEMA 5-20P. Ask Peak which outlet to have installed before the electrician comes.
decision_points: Choose between Fuji and Everest on wood and price, since size and power match.
Requires its own 20-amp circuit.
Peak lists 385 pounds, 80 more than Everest.
limitations: Peak doesn't name the plug type or the minimum clearances for the Fuji.

entries.heading: Outdoor infrared that needs 240 volts
entries.summary: Peak Patagonia is a 2-person outdoor infrared sauna, 52 × 42 × 83 inches in aluminum and Hemlock, on a dedicated 240 V, 20 A circuit at 3,350 W.
paragraphs: Patagonia is Peak's two-seat outdoor model, with an aerospace-grade aluminum shell and Canadian Hemlock inside. Its footprint of 52 × 42 inches is close to the indoor Everest, but it stands 8 inches taller at 83 inches. Interior space is 44 × 38 inches with 77 inches of height.

This one runs at 3,350 watts on 240 volts and needs a dedicated 20-amp circuit. You can't use a regular outdoor outlet, so budget for a 240-volt run from the panel. The cabin weighs 798 pounds, which is worth knowing when you plan the pad.
decision_points: The smaller of Peak's outdoor models, next to Kilimanjaro and El Capitan.
240 volts at the pad is the main extra cost to price out.
Almost 800 pounds, so ask how it gets to the backyard.
limitations: Peak doesn't state the plug or wiring method, foundation requirements or clearances for the Patagonia.

entries.heading: Square cabin, under 36 inches wide
entries.summary: JNH Tosi 1-Person is an indoor infrared sauna for one, 35.5 × 35.5 × 75 inches in Canadian Hemlock, with 1,320 W on a 120 V household plug.
paragraphs: A 35.5-inch square is all the floor JNH's one-person Tosi takes. The full-spectrum infrared cabin is 75 inches tall, and the inside measures 33 × 33 × 72 inches, so you lose only a few inches to the walls. The wood is Canadian Hemlock and the cabin weighs 250 pounds.

JNH says a standard 15-amp household outlet is enough for the one- and two-person Tosi models. This one is rated at 1,320 watts and 120 volts, which works out to about 11 amps. Whether the circuit should be dedicated isn't stated.
decision_points: Nearly a foot narrower than the two-person Tosi.
A normal household 15-amp supply is all it asks for.
Its square shape works in a corner from either side, if the door has room to open.
limitations: JNH doesn't list wall clearances or package dimensions for the one-person Tosi.

entries.heading: Cedar for two on a household plug
entries.summary: JNH Tosi 2-Person is an indoor infrared sauna in Canadian Red Cedar, 47.3 × 39.5 × 75 inches, running on a 120 V, 1,540 W plug-in supply.
paragraphs: The two-seat Tosi is 47.3 inches wide and 39.5 inches deep, about a foot wider than the single and only 4 inches deeper. Inside it measures 45 × 37 × 72.5 inches. JNH builds it in Canadian Red Cedar, where the one-person model uses Hemlock.

At 1,540 watts and 120 volts it pulls just under 13 amps. JNH's FAQ says a standard 15-amp outlet is sufficient for this size, so no new wiring is required if you already have a free 15-amp supply. A hair dryer or space heater on the same breaker would still overload it.
decision_points: Two seats without a 20-amp circuit, unlike the four-person Tosi Red.
330 pounds in total.
At 39.5 inches it is 4.5 inches shallower than Peak's indoor two-seaters.
limitations: JNH doesn't say if the two-person Tosi needs a dedicated circuit, and gives no wall clearances.

entries.heading: Four seats, 71 inches wide, 20 amps
entries.summary: JNH Tosi Red is a 4-person indoor infrared sauna in Canadian Red Cedar, 70.9 × 47.3 × 75 inches, on a dedicated 120 V, 20 A circuit.
paragraphs: Tosi Red is the family size in JNH's indoor range. The cedar cabin is 70.9 × 47.3 inches on the floor and 75 inches high, so it wants a wall almost 6 feet long. Compared with the two-person Tosi, it is close to 2 feet wider and 8 inches deeper.

JNH asks for a dedicated 120-volt, 20-amp circuit with a NEMA 5-20R socket for its 1,980 watts. The smaller Tosi models run on an ordinary outlet, so this is where an electrician joins the budget. At 530 pounds it is also 200 pounds heavier than the two-person Tosi.
decision_points: Still 120 volts, so no 240-volt line is needed.
Needs a 20-amp socket on its own circuit.
Measure the wall and the delivery route for a 71-inch cabin.
limitations: JNH doesn't publish interior dimensions or clearances for the Tosi Red.

entries.heading: Outdoor cabin on a 120-volt circuit
entries.summary: JNH Arki Outdoor Duo is a 2-person outdoor infrared sauna, 55.25 × 47.25 × 77.5 inches, on a dedicated 120 V, 20 A circuit at 2,350 W.
paragraphs: JNH sells the Arki as an all-season outdoor cabin with an aerospace aluminum and Hemlock build. Outside it measures 55.25 × 47.25 × 77.5 inches. The interior of 45 × 37 × 72.5 inches is the same as the indoor two-person Tosi, so the extra bulk is all shell.

Its full-spectrum system draws 2,350 watts at 120 volts and has a NEMA 5-20P plug. JNH requires a dedicated 20-amp circuit. Staying on 120 volts makes it simpler to wire than Peak's outdoor Patagonia, which needs 240.
decision_points: An outdoor two-seater that stays on 120 volts.
Same interior as the indoor Tosi 2-Person, with 8 more inches of outside width.
450 pounds, so prepare a level base first.
limitations: JNH doesn't state foundation requirements or clearances for the Arki.

entries.heading: Four-person cedar cabin, two wall heights
entries.summary: The Sweat Cabin by Sweat Kingdom is a 4-person red cedar sauna, 72 × 72.5 × 77 inches with 6-foot walls, sold with an 8 kW Harvia KIP heater.
paragraphs: The Sweat Cabin is a traditional red cedar sauna for four with a large picture window, and it can stand indoors or out. With 6-foot walls it is 72 × 72.5 inches and 77 inches high. Sweat Kingdom also sells a 7-foot wall for rooms with more headroom.

The base package comes with a hardwired 8 kW Harvia KIP heater and stones. Sweat Kingdom's product page spells out wiring only for a different Homecraft package, so the circuit for the Harvia is something to get in writing. It is made to order with a listed lead time of five weeks.
decision_points: Pick the 6-foot wall for low ceilings.
Get the Harvia heater's voltage and breaker size before you book an electrician.
Heater and stones are included in the base price.
limitations: Sweat Kingdom doesn't state interior dimensions, clearances or the circuit for the Harvia package on the Sweat Cabin.

entries.heading: A short barrel with a 6 kW heater
entries.summary: The Sweat Barrel is a 2-person red cedar barrel sauna, 72 × 48 × 72 inches, with a hardwired 6 kW Harvia KIP heater on a 30-amp circuit.
paragraphs: Sweat Kingdom's regular Sweat Barrel is 6 feet in diameter but only 4 feet long, the shortest of the sizes on offer. It seats two and is listed for indoor and outdoor use. The curved walls leave less shoulder room than a square cabin of the same width.

A 6 kW Harvia KIP heater with built-in controls and stones is part of the package. It is hardwired on a dedicated 30-amp circuit with 10/2 wire. The supply voltage isn't published, so your electrician will need the heater manual.
decision_points: 48 inches deep, so it fits on a narrow patio.
Heater circuit is spelled out, which isn't true for every Sweat Kingdom model.
Roof and heater upgrades change the price.
limitations: Sweat Kingdom doesn't list the voltage, interior size or clearances for the Sweat Barrel.

entries.heading: Narrow cabin with two bench levels
entries.summary: The Sweat Pod is a 2-person red cedar sauna for indoors or outdoors, 53 × 61.25 × 77.375 inches, with a hardwired 6 kW Harvia KIP heater.
paragraphs: The regular Sweat Pod is 53 inches wide, 19 inches narrower than Sweat Kingdom's Sweat Cabin. It is deeper than it is wide at 61.25 inches, with an upper and a lower bench inside. The interior measures 47.375 × 51 inches and 70.375 inches high.

Heat comes from a hardwired 6 kW Harvia KIP, and stones are included. The wiring figures on the page apply to a Homecraft heater you can choose instead. Ask Sweat Kingdom for the Harvia requirements before planning the circuit.
decision_points: Two people sitting side by side have 47.375 inches to share.
A beveled roof is part of the standard package.
Can go inside or outside.
limitations: Sweat Kingdom doesn't give voltage, amperage or wire size for the Harvia heater in the Sweat Pod, and no clearances.

entries.heading: Small cedar cabin, 91 inches tall
entries.summary: The small Summit is a 2-person outdoor cedar sauna with a pitched steel roof, 64 × 59 × 91 inches, sold with an 8 kW Harvia KIP heater.
paragraphs: Summit is a rectangular outdoor cabin in natural cedar with a pitched steel roof. The two-person size has a 64 × 59-inch footprint and 61 × 50 inches inside. The roof takes it to 91 inches, which leaves 82 inches of height in the room.

Sweat Kingdom shows it with a hardwired 8 kW Harvia KIP heater. That is 2 kW more than the two-seat Ridge gets, and the wiring details online are only for the Homecraft alternative. Get the breaker size for the Harvia before trenching a cable.
decision_points: Check the 91-inch peak against eaves and branches.
Larger four- and six-person versions exist with a deeper floor plan.
Only listed for outdoor use.
limitations: Sweat Kingdom doesn't publish the circuit, weight or clearances for the Summit with Harvia heater.

entries.heading: Nearly square outdoor cabin for two
entries.summary: The Ridge is a 2-person outdoor sauna in red cedar with a steel roof, 59.5 × 59.25 × 89.5 inches, with a 6 kW heater on a 40-amp circuit.
paragraphs: Ridge sits on a footprint of 59.5 × 59.25 inches, so you can turn it whichever way suits the yard. The room inside is 56 × 50 inches and 82 inches high. It is an outdoor model in natural red cedar with a pitched steel roof that reaches 89.5 inches.

Sweat Kingdom fits a 6 kW Homecraft Revive Slim heater and asks for a dedicated 40-amp hardwired circuit in 8/3 wire. That is 10 amps more than the Sweat Barrel needs for the same 6 kW. An electrician will still want the supply voltage, which isn't on the product page.
decision_points: 4.5 inches narrower than the small Summit, at about the same depth.
Plan for a 40-amp hardwired line.
The advertised price is a starting price, and finish options move it.
limitations: Sweat Kingdom doesn't give the voltage, weight or clearances for the Ridge.

entries.heading: The Sweat Pod with extra weather protection
entries.summary: The Sweat Pod Blackout is a 2-person red cedar sauna, 53 × 61.25 × 77.375 inches, with added wall and roof protection and a 6 kW Harvia heater.
paragraphs: Take the regular Sweat Pod, add two protective layers to the side walls and roof, and you have the Blackout. Size and seating don't change. You get the same 47.375 × 51-inch interior for two people in a 53 × 61.25-inch cabin.

The base package has a 6 kW Harvia KIP heater, hardwired, with stones. A 40-amp figure appears on the same product page, but it applies to the Homecraft heater. Ask which circuit the Harvia needs if you keep the standard choice.
decision_points: Worth comparing with the plain Sweat Pod if the sauna will stand in the open.
No extra room for the extra layers; the interior is identical.
Expect five weeks of lead time plus freight.
limitations: Sweat Kingdom doesn't state the Harvia wiring, the weight or the clearances for the Blackout Pod.

entries.heading: Weatherproofed version of the Sweat Cabin
entries.summary: The Sweat Cabin Blackout is a 4-person red cedar sauna, 72 × 72.5 × 77 inches, with protective layers on walls and roof and an 8 kW Harvia.
paragraphs: If you like the four-person Sweat Cabin but plan to leave it outside all year, the Blackout version adds protective layers to its side walls and roof. Everything else on the outside stays the same, 72 × 72.5 inches and 77 inches high with the 6-foot walls. A level, drained base is still your job.

An 8 kW Harvia KIP with built-in controls and stones comes in the base package. The 50-amp circuit mentioned on the page goes with a 9 kW Homecraft heater. Don't size the breaker from that number if you order the Harvia.
decision_points: Same footprint and height as the standard Sweat Cabin.
The two heaters need different circuits, so choose the heater first.
Indoor placement is allowed too, though the Blackout layers only pay off outside.
limitations: Sweat Kingdom doesn't list the interior size or the Harvia circuit for the Blackout Cabin.

entries.heading: Six seats and an 81-inch-wide room
entries.summary: The Ascent is a 6-person outdoor cedar sauna, 84 × 72 × 91 inches with a steel roof, and a 9 kW heater on a dedicated 50-amp circuit.
paragraphs: There is one Ascent and it seats six, where the similar Summit comes in several sizes. The outdoor cabin is 84 × 72 inches on the ground and 91 inches at the top of its pitched steel roof. Inside, the room is 81 inches wide, 61.5 inches deep and 82 inches high.

A 9 kW Homecraft Revive heater with WiFi comes with it. Sweat Kingdom specifies a dedicated 50-amp hardwired circuit in 6/3 wire, so have someone check the panel for capacity before you order. Voltage isn't listed on the page.
decision_points: The lower bench slides, which frees floor space when you want it.
50 amps is a big circuit; get the panel checked early.
Interior is 20 inches wider than the small Summit.
limitations: Sweat Kingdom doesn't publish the voltage, weight or clearances for the Ascent.

entries.heading: Arrives assembled, 99 × 75 inches
entries.summary: The Outpost is a fully assembled outdoor sauna for 4-6 people, 99 × 75 inches and up to 108 inches high, with a 9 kW heater on 50 amps.
paragraphs: Most saunas here come as panels. The Outpost arrives as a finished building with framed and insulated walls, board-and-batten siding and a steel roof that slopes from 88 to 108 inches. It seats four to six in a Western red cedar interior.

Getting it to the pad is the hard part, since a 99 × 75-inch structure has to clear gates, trees and power lines. Electrically it needs a dedicated 50-amp hardwired circuit with #8 wire for its 9 kW Homecraft Revive heater. Shipping and placement aren't in the listed price.
decision_points: Ask for a delivery quote with your address before comparing prices.
Have the foundation ready, because it lands in one piece.
Allow for 108 inches at the high side of the roof.
limitations: Sweat Kingdom doesn't state the Outpost's weight, voltage or interior dimensions.

entries.heading: The smallest of the modular SK cabins
entries.summary: The SK 110 is a modular red cedar sauna for 2-3 people on a 5 × 6 footprint, insulated with wool and sold with heater and stones included.
paragraphs: SK 110 is a modular cabin that starts at a 5 × 6 footprint for two to three people. The same page sells 6 × 8 and 7 × 10 sizes for bigger groups. Walls are insulated with wool and have a vapor barrier, the lining is Western red cedar, and the floor is waterproof rubber.

Heater and stones are included, and the connection is hardwired. Which heater you get depends on the package, and its wattage isn't published. Without that, nobody can size the circuit, so ask for the heater model in the quote.
decision_points: Siding comes in LP Smartside or cedar, with a choice of interior wood.
Price each footprint separately, since size and finish both change it.
Can be set up indoors or outdoors.
limitations: Sweat Kingdom doesn't publish the height, heater model or electrical requirements for the SK 110.

entries.heading: Four seats, or six in the larger size
entries.summary: The SK 210 is a modular cedar sauna for 4 people on a 6 × 8 footprint, with a 7 × 10 size for six, heater and stones included.
paragraphs: Four people is the starting size for the SK 210, on a 6 × 8 footprint. A 7 × 10 version for six sits on the same product page. Construction matches the SK 110, with wool insulation, a Western red cedar lining and waterproof rubber flooring.

You get a hardwired heater and stones with it. Sweat Kingdom leaves the exact heater open until the package is chosen, so budget for electrical work only after you have the model name. If you're undecided on size, ask whether both use the same heater.
decision_points: Choose the footprint first; moving from 6 × 8 to 7 × 10 adds two seats.
Indoor or outdoor placement are both possible.
Leave space around the cabin for assembly and the door.
limitations: Sweat Kingdom doesn't give the SK 210's height, interior dimensions or heater wattage.

entries.heading: One large 7 × 10 footprint
entries.summary: The SK 310 is a modular cedar sauna for 4-5 people on a 7 × 10 footprint, with wool insulation, rubber flooring, a heater and stones.
paragraphs: The SK 310 skips the size menu. It has one 7 × 10 footprint, and Sweat Kingdom rates it for four to five people, one fewer than the 7 × 10 version of the SK 210. Cedar lining, wool insulation and a waterproof rubber floor are the same as in the rest of the SK line.

Like its smaller siblings it ships with stones and a hardwired heater that the page doesn't name. Find out the kilowatts and breaker size while you're choosing siding and interior wood. Those finish options also change the price.
decision_points: Compare it with the 7 × 10 SK 210, which is listed for six.
Needs a path wide enough for modular wall sections.
The price shown is for the base version.
limitations: Sweat Kingdom doesn't publish the SK 310's exterior height, inside measurements or circuit.

entries.heading: A mobile cedar sauna with HUUM heater
entries.summary: The SK Mobile is a movable cedar sauna for 4-5 people with a 6.5 × 8-foot footprint and a HUUM Drop 9 heater in the base version.
paragraphs: SK Mobile is built to be moved, with a 6.5 × 8-foot body that takes four to five people. The cabin itself follows the other SK models, with Western red cedar lining, wool insulation and waterproof rubber flooring. Think of the 6.5 × 8 feet as the sauna only, before any towing gear.

The base price includes a HUUM Drop 9; a HUUM Hive Flow Mini is the alternative. Both the connection and the circuit should be confirmed for the heater you pick, because the page gives neither amps nor voltage. You also need a hardwired supply wherever you plan to park it.
decision_points: Ask for trailer weight and towing requirements before you buy.
Heater choice affects the wiring at every place you use it.
Check local rules on registration and parking.
limitations: Sweat Kingdom doesn't publish trailer dimensions, weight or electrical details for the SK Mobile.

entries.heading: Sauna and cold plunge, two circuits
entries.summary: The SK Contrast is a pre-built outdoor suite with sauna and cold plunge in 8 × 10, 8 × 12 or 8 × 16 feet, wired on 50-amp and 20-amp circuits.
paragraphs: SK Contrast puts a traditional sauna and a cold plunge into one pre-built outdoor structure. You choose between 8 × 10, 8 × 12 and 8 × 16 feet, with several wood packages and an optional shower. Wood choices include tight-knot red cedar, thermo spruce and thermo aspen.

It needs two circuits. The sauna is hardwired on 50 amps with 6/3 wire, and the plunge has its own dedicated 20-amp line. Because the suite arrives built, the delivery route and a way to lift it into place matter as much as the wiring.
decision_points: The shortest version is 10 feet, the longest 16.
Plan for water and drainage as well as power.
The price starts with the base layout and rises with shower, wood and size.
limitations: Sweat Kingdom doesn't state how many people the SK Contrast seats.
Heater power and voltage are missing too.

entries.heading: REGEN cabin with a 9 kW heater
entries.summary: The REGEN Sweat Cabin is a 4-person red cedar sauna, 72 × 72.5 × 77 inches with 6-foot walls, with a 9 kW heater on a 50-amp circuit.
paragraphs: Four people fit in this REGEN cabin, or four to six according to a note on Sweat Kingdom's page. With 6-foot walls it measures 72 × 72.5 × 77 inches, the same as the regular Sweat Cabin. A 7-foot wall takes it to 89 inches. Both have a beveled cedar roof and tempered glass.

Here the heater is a 9 kW Homecraft Revive, and the wiring is spelled out as a dedicated 50-amp circuit, hardwired in 6/3. The regular Sweat Cabin comes with an 8 kW Harvia and no stated circuit. That makes the REGEN easier to price, electrician included.
decision_points: Take the 7-foot wall only if the room or canopy allows 89 inches.
Indoor and outdoor use are both listed.
Compare it with the Deluxe if six seats are the goal.
limitations: Sweat Kingdom doesn't list voltage, phase or interior size for the four-person REGEN cabin.

entries.heading: 11 inches wider than the REGEN cabin
entries.summary: The REGEN Sweat Cabin Deluxe is a 6-person red cedar sauna, 83 × 72.5 × 89 inches, with a hardwired 9 kW Homecraft heater on 50 amps.
paragraphs: Going from the four-person REGEN cabin to the Deluxe adds 11 inches of width and fixes the height at 89 inches, with 7-foot walls. Depth stays at 72.5 inches. Sweat Kingdom rates it for six people, indoors or out, with a beveled cedar roof.

Heater and circuit don't change with the size. It uses the same 9 kW Homecraft Revive on a dedicated 50-amp line in 6/3 wire. A HUUM heater also appears on the page as an option, and it would need its own check.
decision_points: At 89 inches it leaves 7 inches under an 8-foot ceiling. Ask if that is enough.
Two more seats for the same electrical work as the smaller REGEN cabin.
Ask for a bench drawing to see how six people actually sit.
limitations: Sweat Kingdom doesn't give the Deluxe's interior dimensions or supply voltage.

entries.heading: Two sizes, two different circuits
entries.summary: The REGEN Sweat Pod is a red cedar sauna at 53 × 61.25 inches for 1-2 people with a 6 kW heater, or 85.25 inches deep for four.
paragraphs: REGEN sells the Pod in two sizes. The regular one is for one to two people and matches the standard Sweat Pod at 53 × 61.25 × 77.375 inches, with 47.375 × 51 inches inside. The four-person size is 85.25 inches deep and 89.375 inches high, so it takes up 2 more feet and won't fit every room that suits the small one.
The regular Pod has a 6 kW Homecraft Revive on a 40-amp hardwired circuit in 8/3 wire. The large one steps up to 9 kW and 50 amps in 6/3. Decide on the size before you hire the electrician.
decision_points: One product page covers both sizes, so double-check which one is in the cart.
The large size stands a foot taller than the regular one.
Suitable for indoor or outdoor placement.
limitations: Sweat Kingdom doesn't list voltage or clearances for either REGEN Pod.

entries.heading: A 42-inch cedar box, currently sold out
entries.summary: The Sweat Box is a 1-person red cedar sauna, 42 × 42 × 80 inches, with a 4 kW hardwired heater on 30 amps. Sweat Kingdom lists it as sold out.
paragraphs: One person, 42 × 42 inches, 80 inches high. The Sweat Box is the smallest traditional sauna from Sweat Kingdom on this site, with red cedar, tempered glass, wool insulation and a flat rubber floor. It can be placed inside or outside.

Its WiFi-controlled 4 kW Homecraft Revive Slim still needs a dedicated, hardwired 30-amp circuit, so a small sauna doesn't mean plugging it into the wall here. The model was sold out when we last checked, which is why we show no price. Ask Sweat Kingdom about a restock before you plan around it.
decision_points: 11 inches narrower than the Sweat Pod.
Hardwired despite its size.
If you need one now, look at the regular Pod.
limitations: Sweat Kingdom doesn't publish the interior size, voltage or clearances of the Sweat Box.

entries.heading: Red cedar for one, no dedicated circuit
entries.summary: Peak Rainier is a 1-person indoor infrared sauna in Canadian Red Cedar, 42 × 40 × 75 inches, with 1,800 W on a 120 V, 15 A plug.
paragraphs: Rainier is the cedar counterpart to Shasta. Both are 42 × 40 × 75 inches outside, 38 × 36 × 67 inches inside and 305 pounds. Rainier has a full-spectrum infrared system and walls of Canadian Red Cedar.

It plugs in with a NEMA 5-15P and runs at 1,800 watts and 15 amps on 120 volts. Peak says a dedicated circuit isn't required. Since the sauna alone draws the full 15 amps, though, expect a tripped breaker if a vacuum or heater shares the line.
decision_points: Shasta or Rainier comes down to Hemlock or red cedar.
Works with an ordinary household outlet.
Interior height is 67 inches, the same as Shasta, Everest and Fuji.
limitations: Peak doesn't state shipping dimensions or wall clearances for the Rainier.

entries.heading: Three seats on a 240-volt plug
entries.summary: Peak Matterhorn is a 3-person indoor infrared sauna in Canadian Red Cedar, 61 × 44 × 75 inches, with 2,850 W on a 240 V, 20 A circuit.
paragraphs: For three people indoors, Peak offers the Matterhorn, a full-spectrum infrared cabin in Canadian Red Cedar. It is 61 inches wide, 8 inches more than Everest and Fuji, and keeps their 44-inch depth and 75-inch height. Inside there are 57 × 40 inches of floor.

This is also the point where Peak's indoor range leaves 120 volts. The 2,850-watt system needs a dedicated 240-volt, 20-amp circuit and a NEMA 6-20 outlet. Few spare rooms have one, so get a quote for the wiring first.
decision_points: One more seat than Fuji for 8 inches of width and a 240-volt line.
Weighs 400 pounds.
Plugs in, so no hardwiring at the sauna itself.
limitations: Peak doesn't publish clearances or delivery dimensions for the Matterhorn.

entries.heading: Five seats on a 59-inch square
entries.summary: Peak Kilimanjaro is a 5-person outdoor infrared sauna, 59 × 59 × 83 inches in aluminum and Hemlock, with 4,850 W on a 240 V, 30 A circuit.
paragraphs: Kilimanjaro has a square plan, 59 × 59 inches, and stands 83 inches high. Peak rates the full-spectrum outdoor cabin for five, one more than the wider El Capitan. Outside it is aerospace-grade aluminum, inside Canadian Hemlock.

Its infrared system is rated at 4,850 watts on 240 volts and 30 amps, on a dedicated circuit with a NEMA L6-30P plug. That is a locking plug, so it needs the matching outlet rather than a dryer socket. At 1,031 pounds, it also needs a base that can take the weight.
decision_points: Five people share a 59 × 59-inch cabin, so ask Peak for the bench layout.
The heaviest Peak model here.
22 inches narrower than El Capitan.
limitations: Peak doesn't give interior dimensions for the Kilimanjaro.
Ask whether it is wired in or plugged in, since the details we found mention both.

entries.heading: Peak's widest cabin, 81 inches
entries.summary: Peak El Capitan is a 4-person outdoor infrared sauna, 81 × 55 × 83 inches in aluminum and Hemlock, with 5,300 W on a 240 V, 30 A circuit.
paragraphs: Nearly 7 feet wide, El Capitan is Peak's broadest outdoor model. It seats four in an interior of 76 × 50 inches with 77 inches of height. Outside dimensions are 81 × 55 × 83 inches, with an aerospace-grade aluminum shell over Canadian Hemlock.

With 5,300 watts it is also the most powerful Peak here, 450 watts above Kilimanjaro. Both run on 240 volts and 30 amps with a NEMA L6-30P plug. The dedicated circuit has to reach the pad, which can cost real money if the panel is on the far side of the house.
decision_points: Lighter than Kilimanjaro at 695 pounds.
One seat fewer than Kilimanjaro on a wider, shallower footprint.
Needs a 30-amp, 240-volt supply outdoors.
limitations: Peak doesn't describe the foundation or clearances El Capitan needs.
Plug-in and hardwired connection are both mentioned, so confirm which applies.

entries.heading: A shallow two-seat kit in spruce
entries.summary: Almost Heaven Hillsboro is a 2-person indoor traditional sauna kit in spruce, 63 × 45.25 × 80.3125 inches, with a 6 kW heater on 240 V and 30 A.
paragraphs: Hillsboro is a traditional spruce kit for two, meant for indoors. It is 63 inches wide and 45.25 inches deep, with 58.25 × 39.375 inches left inside. At just over 80 inches tall it stands under a normal 8-foot ceiling, and the room itself has 78 inches of height.
A 6 kW heater at 240 volts needs a dedicated 30-amp circuit and is hardwired. You can't plug it into a wall outlet, so have an electrician price the run from your panel before choosing a room.
decision_points: 10 inches wider than the one-person Logan and 9 inches deeper.
If you want a third seat, Madison is only 2 inches wider.
Hardwired, so no moving it to another room later without rewiring.
limitations: Almost Heaven doesn't publish clearances for the Hillsboro on its product page.

entries.heading: Four seats in a 6-foot-long barrel
entries.summary: Almost Heaven Pinnacle is a 4-person outdoor barrel sauna kit, 78 × 71 × 81.5 inches, with a traditional 6 kW heater on 240 V and 30 A.
paragraphs: Pinnacle is the plain four-person barrel in Almost Heaven's range, with no canopy. The outside measures 78 inches wide, 71 inches deep and 81.5 inches high. Inside, the barrel is 75.25 inches across, 63.25 inches long and 69.25 inches high. It comes in Rustic Red Cedar or Onyx.

The heater is rated at 6 kW, 240 volts and 30 amps. Almost Heaven doesn't spell out the circuit size for this kit, nor how it connects. Any 6 kW sauna heater at 240 volts means a new line to the yard, so include trenching or conduit in the budget.
decision_points: Audra has the same 78 × 71-inch footprint but gives up 12 inches of room for a canopy.
2 kW and 10 amps below the six-person Princeton.
The highest point is 81.5 inches.
limitations: Almost Heaven doesn't state the required circuit or foundation for the Pinnacle.

entries.heading: A one-person kit, 36 inches deep
entries.summary: Almost Heaven Logan is a 1-person indoor traditional sauna kit in spruce, 53.25 × 36 × 77.625 inches, with a 6 kW heater on 240 V and 30 A.
paragraphs: If you want a traditional sauna for yourself and have a hallway or bathroom wall free, Logan is 53.25 inches wide and only 36 inches deep. The interior is 49 × 31.75 inches with 76.125 inches of height. Spruce is standard and cedar is an option.

Being small doesn't make it easy to wire. It uses a 6 kW, 240-volt heater on a dedicated 30-amp circuit, hardwired, the same as the two-seat Hillsboro. Electrical cost will be about the same for either, so decide on space.
decision_points: The smallest Almost Heaven kit we cover.
Almost a foot narrower than Madison and 17 inches shallower.
Same circuit as the two-person kit.
limitations: Almost Heaven doesn't list wall clearances or package sizes for the Logan.

entries.heading: Nearly 8 feet long, seats six
entries.summary: Almost Heaven Princeton is a 6-person outdoor barrel sauna kit, 78 × 94 × 75.375 inches, with an 8 kW traditional heater on 240 V and 40 A.
paragraphs: Princeton puts six people in a barrel 78 inches wide and 94 inches long. Because there is no canopy, most of that length is sauna. The interior runs 86.375 inches, 23 inches more than the same-size Charleston. Rustic Red Cedar and Onyx are the two looks on offer.

An 8 kW heater at 240 volts and 40 amps heats the larger space. Almost Heaven doesn't say which circuit to install or how it connects, so use the heater's own manual for wire and breaker size. From the panel's point of view, 40 amps is about what an electric range takes.
decision_points: Choose this over Charleston if you want seats more than a covered porch.
Needs a level base about 8 feet long.
75.375 inches high, 6 inches lower than Pinnacle.
limitations: Almost Heaven doesn't give a required circuit, shipping size or foundation plan for the Princeton.

entries.heading: Four seats in under 6 feet
entries.summary: Almost Heaven Rainelle is a 4-person indoor traditional sauna kit, 71.5 × 62.75 × 77.625 inches, with an 8 kW heater on a 240 V, 40 A circuit.
paragraphs: For a family-size sauna in a basement or spare room, Rainelle needs 71.5 × 62.75 inches of floor. It is the shallower of Almost Heaven's two four-person indoor kits. Inside you get 66.75 × 58.375 inches and 76.125 inches of height, in cedar or Hemlock.

Plan on a dedicated 40-amp circuit at 240 volts for the hardwired 8 kW heater. That is a step up from the 30 amps of the smaller Hillsboro and Madison, and it may be what decides between three seats and four.
decision_points: 8.75 inches shallower than Grayson at the same width.
77.625 inches tall, so measure low basement ceilings and ducts.
Cedar or Hemlock.
limitations: Almost Heaven doesn't publish the clearances around the Rainelle.

entries.heading: Short barrel with a covered front
entries.summary: Almost Heaven Audra is a 2-4 person outdoor canopy barrel sauna kit, 78 × 71 × 75.375 inches, with a 6 kW heater on 240 V and 30 A.
paragraphs: Audra gives you a covered spot outside the door without a long barrel. The footprint is 78 × 71 inches, the same as Pinnacle, but the canopy takes a foot of it. That leaves 51.25 inches of interior length for two to four people. Finishes are Rustic Red Cedar and Onyx.

Heat comes from a 6 kW heater at 240 volts and 30 amps. Almost Heaven doesn't state the circuit size or connection for this kit, and it will need an outdoor line either way. Put the barrel where the cable run is short if the view allows it.
decision_points: For four people, compare it with Pinnacle and its 63.25-inch interior.
Canopy included in the 71-inch depth.
Lowest heater rating in the Almost Heaven barrel range, along with Pinnacle.
limitations: Almost Heaven doesn't publish the required circuit or canopy clearances for the Audra.

entries.heading: Six seats along a 7-foot wall
entries.summary: Almost Heaven Bridgeport is a 6-person indoor traditional sauna kit, 86 × 63 × 77.625 inches, with an 8 kW heater on a 240 V, 40 A circuit.
paragraphs: Bridgeport spreads six seats along a long wall. At 86 inches it is the widest indoor Almost Heaven kit here, but it is just 63 inches deep. The room inside measures 81.25 × 58.5 inches, and you can have it in cedar or Hemlock.

Its 8 kW heater runs on 240 volts with a dedicated 40-amp circuit, hardwired. The four-person Rainelle and Grayson use the same circuit, so going to six seats costs floor space without adding electrical work.
decision_points: 9 inches shallower than Titan, 2.75 inches wider.
Best in a long, narrow room.
The panel needs space for 40 amps.
limitations: Almost Heaven doesn't give ventilation or wall clearances for the Bridgeport.

entries.heading: Taller barrel with canopy, 9 kW heater
entries.summary: Almost Heaven Grandview is a 4-6 person outdoor canopy barrel sauna kit, 82.375 × 94 × 85.875 inches, with a 9 kW heater on 240 V and 45 A.
paragraphs: Grandview is one of two larger-diameter barrels from Almost Heaven. The room inside is 79.625 inches high, about 10 inches more than in the 78-inch barrels. It seats four to six in 74.25 inches of length, with a canopy making up the rest of the 94 inches.
You'll need a dedicated 45-amp, 240-volt circuit for the hardwired 9 kW heater. That is 5 amps more than Huntington, the closest model in the smaller diameter. Cedar and Hemlock are the listed woods.
decision_points: Same outside size as Lewisburg, which swaps the canopy for 12 more inches of interior.
85.875 inches high, so look up for branches and eaves.
More headroom than Charleston and Huntington.
limitations: Almost Heaven doesn't state shipping dimensions or canopy clearances for the Grandview.

entries.heading: Six seats and a 9 kW heater
entries.summary: Almost Heaven Titan is a 6-person indoor traditional sauna kit, 83.25 × 72.25 × 79.375 inches, with a 9 kW heater on a 240 V, 45 A circuit.
paragraphs: Titan has the strongest heater among Almost Heaven's indoor kits on this site, 9 kW where the other six-seaters have 8. The cabin is 83.25 × 72.25 inches outside and 78.75 × 68.75 inches inside. Cedar and Hemlock are available.

That heater calls for a dedicated 45-amp circuit at 240 volts and is wired in permanently. Have the electrician check the panel's spare capacity, because 45 amps on top of a range and dryer is too much for some older houses.
decision_points: 9 inches deeper than Bridgeport and nearly 3 inches narrower.
45 amps against 40 for Patterson and Bridgeport.
79.375 inches tall.
limitations: Almost Heaven doesn't publish minimum clearances for the Titan.

entries.heading: A square six-person kit
entries.summary: Almost Heaven Patterson is a 6-person indoor traditional sauna kit, 81.875 × 81.875 × 80.3125 inches, with an 8 kW heater on a 240 V, 40 A circuit.
paragraphs: Both sides of Patterson measure 81.875 inches, so it suits a corner in a larger basement better than a narrow room. Six people share an interior of 77.125 × 77.125 inches, which is the deepest room of Almost Heaven's indoor kits here. It is 78 inches high inside and comes in cedar or Hemlock.
The hardwired heater is 8 kW at 240 volts on a dedicated 40-amp circuit. Titan needs 45 amps for a smaller floor area, so Patterson is slightly easier on the panel.
decision_points: Almost 7 feet in both directions, before you leave space for the door.
4 inches narrower than Bridgeport but 19 inches deeper.
Outside height just over 80 inches.
limitations: Almost Heaven doesn't list working clearances or crate sizes for the Patterson.

entries.heading: The biggest Almost Heaven barrel here
entries.summary: Almost Heaven Lewisburg is a 6-8 person outdoor barrel sauna kit, 82.375 × 94 × 85.875 inches, with a 9 kW heater on a 240 V, 45 A circuit.
paragraphs: Groups of six to eight are what Lewisburg is for. No other Almost Heaven barrel on this site holds as many. The interior is 86.25 inches long and 79.625 inches high inside an 82.375 × 94-inch shell, with cedar and Hemlock listed as the woods.
The hardwired 9 kW heater takes a dedicated 45-amp circuit at 240 volts, the same as Grandview. Before ordering, check that your panel can spare 45 amps and work out how the cable gets to the sauna.
decision_points: Two more seats than Princeton for 4 inches of width and the same length.
No canopy; Grandview is the covered version of this size.
Nearly 86 inches high.
limitations: Almost Heaven doesn't describe the base or the clearances needed for the Lewisburg.

entries.heading: Square four-seater for a corner
entries.summary: Almost Heaven Grayson is a 4-person indoor traditional sauna kit, 71.5 × 71.5 × 77.625 inches, with an 8 kW heater on a 240 V, 40 A circuit.
paragraphs: Grayson and Rainelle are the same width and height and both seat four. Grayson is deeper, making it a 71.5-inch square with a 66.75 × 67-inch interior. If you have the floor space, that extra depth is the whole difference. Both come in cedar or Hemlock.
Electrically there is nothing to choose between them. Each needs a dedicated 240-volt, 40-amp circuit for a hardwired 8 kW heater.
decision_points: 8.75 inches deeper than Rainelle.
10 inches smaller than Patterson on each side.
Interior height is 76.125 inches.
limitations: Almost Heaven doesn't give wall or ceiling clearances for the Grayson.

entries.heading: Long barrel, deep canopy, four seats
entries.summary: Almost Heaven Charleston is a 4-person outdoor canopy barrel sauna kit, 78 × 94 × 75.375 inches, with an 8 kW heater on a 240 V, 40 A circuit.
paragraphs: On a 78 × 94-inch footprint, Charleston gives a good part of the length to its covered front. The sauna inside is 63.375 inches long and seats four, the same room length as the much shorter Pinnacle. You pay for the porch in yard space. Cedar and Hemlock are listed.
An 8 kW heater is hardwired on a dedicated 240-volt, 40-amp circuit. Pinnacle manages four seats with 6 kW and 30 amps, so compare the wiring quotes if you are torn between the two.
decision_points: Choose Huntington for 11 more inches inside with a smaller canopy.
About 8 feet of depth, plus room to walk up to it.
75.375 inches high.
limitations: Almost Heaven doesn't list canopy clearances or shipping dimensions for the Charleston.

entries.heading: Covered barrel with a longer room
entries.summary: Almost Heaven Huntington is a 4-6 person outdoor canopy barrel sauna kit, 78 × 94 × 75.375 inches, with an 8 kW heater on a 240 V, 40 A circuit.
paragraphs: Three Almost Heaven barrels share the 78 × 94-inch footprint, and Huntington is the middle one. Its interior is 74.25 inches long, between Charleston's 63.375 and Princeton's 86.375. You keep a canopy and still seat four to six. The kit comes in cedar or Hemlock.
Expect an 8 kW heater, hardwired, on its own 40-amp circuit at 240 volts. The requirement matches Charleston's, so the choice between them is about how much of the length should be porch.
decision_points: A foot shorter inside than Princeton, with a covered front in return.
Room height is 69.25 inches; Grandview has 79.625.
Seats up to six on a 40-amp line.
limitations: Almost Heaven doesn't publish foundation details or canopy clearances for the Huntington.

entries.heading: Room for three on 30 amps
entries.summary: Almost Heaven Madison is a 2-3 person indoor traditional sauna kit, 65 × 53 × 77.625 inches, with a 6 kW heater on a 240 V, 30 A circuit.
paragraphs: Almost Heaven lists Madison for two to three people. The kit is 65 × 53 inches, 2 inches wider and nearly 8 inches deeper than Hillsboro. It has a 60.25 × 48.5-inch interior and is comes in cedar or Hemlock, where Hillsboro is spruce.
It still runs on the smaller electrical setup, a 6 kW heater hardwired to a dedicated 30-amp, 240-volt circuit. For a fourth seat you would move to Rainelle and 40 amps.
decision_points: The largest Almost Heaven indoor kit here that stays at 30 amps.
2.7 inches lower than Hillsboro at 77.625 inches.
Interior height 76.125 inches.
limitations: Almost Heaven doesn't state shipping dimensions or clearances for the Madison.

entries.heading: Three seats on a 20-amp plug
entries.summary: Sun Home Equinox is a 3-person indoor infrared sauna in Eucalyptus, 62.3 × 45.9 × 77.7 inches, with 2,250 W on a dedicated 120 V, 20 A circuit.
paragraphs: Equinox is a three-seat infrared cabin in Eucalyptus, for indoor use. It measures 62.3 × 45.9 inches and stands 77.7 inches tall, with 56.8 × 39.9 inches of floor inside. Peak's three-person Matterhorn is about the same size but runs on 240 volts.

Here 120 volts is enough. The 2,250-watt system plugs in with a NEMA 5-20P and needs its own 20-amp circuit. A standard 15-amp outlet won't accept that plug, so check for a 20-amp outlet before ordering.
decision_points: Three seats without a 240-volt line.
Weighs 546 pounds.
Over 10 inches wider than Sun Home's Eclipse 2.
limitations: Sun Home doesn't state wall clearances or package dimensions for the Equinox.

entries.heading: Two seats that need a 30-amp circuit
entries.summary: Sun Home Eclipse 2 is a 2-person indoor infrared sauna in Eucalyptus, 51.5 × 47.2 × 76.7 inches, at 2,820 W on a 120 V, 30 A circuit.
paragraphs: Eclipse 2 seats two in a Eucalyptus infrared cabin that is 51.5 × 47.2 inches and 76.7 inches high. The walls are thick for the size. Inside, you have 42.8 × 42.2 inches, close to 9 inches less than the outside width.

The catch is the power. It draws 2,820 watts, 23.5 amps at 120 volts, and wants a dedicated 30-amp circuit with a NEMA L5-30P locking plug. Homes rarely have that outlet, so expect electrician work even though it's 120 volts.
decision_points: Draws more than the three-person Equinox.
Needs a locking 30-amp outlet that you probably don't have.
600 pounds in total.
limitations: Sun Home doesn't publish clearances or shipping dimensions for the Eclipse 2.

entries.heading: Eight seats on a 90-inch square
entries.summary: Redwood Outdoors Garden 8 is an 8-person outdoor sauna kit in heat-treated Hemlock, 90.5 × 90.875 × 87.25 inches, with an 8 kW, 240 V heater.
paragraphs: Garden is an eight-person outdoor kit in heat-treated Hemlock. Give it a pad of at least 90.5 × 90.875 inches, about 7.5 feet each way, plus space to open the door and work around it. It is 87.25 inches high.
The heater is listed at 8 kW, 240 volts and 40 amps. Redwood doesn't say what circuit to install or how the heater connects, so base the electrician's quote on the manual for that heater.
decision_points: About 6 inches smaller per side than Grove, with 2 kW more heater.
Wider and shorter than the 8-person barrel.
Level pad of roughly 8 × 8 feet.
limitations: Redwood doesn't publish interior dimensions or the required circuit for the Garden 8.

entries.heading: The largest Redwood model we list
entries.summary: Redwood Outdoors Grove 8 is an 8-person outdoor sauna kit in heat-treated Hemlock, 96.25 × 96.25 × 94.875 inches, with a 6 kW, 240 V heater.
paragraphs: No Redwood sauna on this site takes up more ground than Grove. It is 96.25 inches on each side, just over 8 feet, and nearly as tall at 94.875 inches. Redwood rates it for eight people and builds it from heat-treated Hemlock.

Surprisingly, its heater is smaller than Garden's, 6 kW and 30 amps at 240 volts against 8 kW and 40 amps. That makes the cable run cheaper. Ask Redwood which heater it suggests for eight people before you settle on the lower number.
decision_points: Slightly over 8 feet square, so a standard 8 × 8 pad is too small.
30-amp heater where Garden, Noctra and Barrel 8 need 40.
Almost 8 feet tall.
limitations: Redwood doesn't list the Grove's interior dimensions, weight or foundation requirements.

entries.heading: Six seats in Canadian Thermowood
entries.summary: Redwood Outdoors Vista 6 is a 6-person outdoor sauna kit in Canadian Thermowood, 71 × 72.75 × 76.5 inches, with a 6 kW heater at 240 V and 30 A.
paragraphs: For a smaller yard, Vista seats six on 71 × 72.75 inches, with a height of 76.5 inches. Those are the same numbers as Redwood's Barrel 6. The two part ways on wood, with Canadian Thermowood here and heat-treated Hemlock on the barrel.
Redwood lists a 6 kW heater at 240 volts and 30 amps and offers other heater choices. Settle on the heater before wiring, since Redwood gives no circuit or connection type with the cabin.
decision_points: About 6 feet square, as small as Redwood's six-person kits get here.
Weighs 900 pounds, same as Barrel 6.
Compare with Summit if you need a shallower plan.
limitations: Redwood doesn't state the interior size or minimum clearances for the Vista 6.

entries.heading: Redwood's standard six-person barrel
entries.summary: Redwood Outdoors Barrel 6 is a 6-person outdoor barrel sauna in heat-treated Hemlock, 71 × 72.75 × 76.5 inches, with a 6 kW, 240 V heater.
paragraphs: Barrel 6 is the basic round model in Redwood's outdoor line. Six people are listed for a barrel of about 6 feet in each direction, 71 × 72.75 × 76.5 inches. It is built from heat-treated Hemlock and weighs 900 pounds.
Its 6 kW heater is rated for 30 amps at 240 volts. Other heaters can be ordered, and Redwood doesn't name a breaker size or connection, so wait for the final heater choice before running cable.
decision_points: The porch version adds close to 20 inches of depth.
Extra-Wide is 12 inches taller if headroom matters.
Same size as Vista, in different wood.
limitations: Redwood doesn't publish inside dimensions or a base specification for the Barrel 6.

entries.heading: A porch adds 20 inches of depth
entries.summary: Redwood Outdoors Barrel with Porch is a 6-person outdoor sauna in heat-treated Hemlock, 72.75 × 92.5 × 76.5 inches, with a 6 kW, 240 V heater.
paragraphs: Same barrel idea, with a covered front to step out onto. The porch takes the depth to 92.5 inches, while width and height stay in barrel territory at 72.75 and 76.5 inches. Seating is still six, in heat-treated Hemlock.
Nothing changes electrically from the plain Barrel 6. The heater is 6 kW at 240 volts and 30 amps, and Redwood leaves the circuit size and connection to the heater manual.
decision_points: Nearly 8 feet long, so check the setback from a fence.
Horizon has the same outside measurements and is rated for four to six.
The extra depth goes to the porch; seating stays at six.
limitations: Redwood doesn't say how much of the 92.5 inches is porch, and gives no weight or clearances.

entries.heading: A taller barrel for six
entries.summary: Redwood Outdoors Extra-Wide Barrel is a 6-person outdoor sauna in Canadian Thermowood, 71.75 × 84.75 × 88.5 inches, with a 6 kW, 240 V heater.
paragraphs: Extra-Wide still seats six but is a foot taller than the standard barrel, 88.5 inches against 76.5. On the ground it needs 71.75 × 84.75 inches. Redwood builds it from Canadian Thermowood, and it weighs 1,245 pounds.
Despite the bigger shell, Redwood lists the same 6 kW heater at 240 volts and 30 amps as on Barrel 6. If you upgrade the heater, the wiring changes too, and no circuit size is given for either case.
decision_points: 345 pounds heavier than Barrel 6.
88.5 inches high, so check for branches and roof overhangs.
The porch model is in Hemlock and deeper.
limitations: Redwood gives 84.75 inches as depth here and as width on the porch version, so confirm which way it faces.
Interior dimensions for the Extra-Wide aren't published.

entries.heading: Porch sauna rated for four to six
entries.summary: Redwood Outdoors Horizon seats 4-6 in an outdoor sauna with porch, 72.75 × 92.5 × 76.5 inches in heat-treated Hemlock, with a 6 kW, 240 V heater.
paragraphs: Horizon has a porch at the front and a footprint of 72.75 × 92.5 inches. The outside dimensions are identical to Redwood's Barrel with Porch, though this one is rated for four to six people. The wood is heat-treated Hemlock and the height is 76.5 inches.

Redwood offers it with a 6 kW heater at 240 volts and 30 amps. Circuit size and connection type aren't given, so your electrician should work from the heater manual. Plan the cable route around the porch.
decision_points: Leave a path in front of the porch, on top of the 92.5 inches.
If you don't need the porch, Vista and Barrel 6 save 20 inches of depth.
Compare with the Barrel with Porch, which is listed for six.
limitations: Redwood doesn't break out the porch depth, interior size or clearances for the Horizon.

entries.heading: Wide and shallow, for six
entries.summary: Redwood Outdoors Summit 6 is a 6-person outdoor sauna kit in heat-treated Hemlock, 82 × 69.5 × 82.75 inches, with a 6 kW heater at 240 V and 30 A.
paragraphs: Where most of Redwood's six-person kits run deep, Summit runs wide. The rectangular cabin is 82 inches across and 69.5 inches deep, which works along a fence or house wall. It stands 82.75 inches tall and is made of heat-treated Hemlock.
The listed heater is 6 kW, 240 volts and 30 amps, the usual figure for Redwood's six-seaters. You still need to ask for the breaker size and connection.
decision_points: At 69.5 inches it is 3 inches shallower than Vista or Barrel 6.
11 inches wider than Vista.
Leaves 23 inches more yard in front than the porch models.
limitations: Redwood doesn't publish the Summit's interior, weight or packaging dimensions.

entries.heading: Extra-wide barrel plus porch
entries.summary: Redwood Outdoors Extra-Wide Barrel with Porch seats 6 outdoors, 84.75 × 92.5 × 88.5 inches in Canadian heat-treated Hemlock, with a 6 kW heater.
paragraphs: This is the biggest six-person barrel from Redwood here, 84.75 inches wide, 92.5 inches deep including the porch and 88.5 inches high. It is a foot wider and a foot taller than the standard Barrel with Porch. Material is Canadian heat-treated Hemlock, 1,234 pounds in total.

Its 6 kW heater matches the smaller barrels at 240 volts and 30 amps. Redwood lists a crate of 42.1 × 94.1 × 40 inches, so measure the gate and driveway along with the pad. Wire and breaker size aren't stated.
decision_points: Same seats as the standard porch barrel, in a larger shell.
The crate is almost 8 feet long.
Check eaves and branches for 88.5 inches of height.
limitations: Redwood doesn't list interior dimensions or clearances for the Extra-Wide with Porch.

entries.heading: Eight seats and an 8 kW heater
entries.summary: Redwood Outdoors Barrel 8 is an 8-person outdoor barrel sauna in Canadian Thermowood, 72.75 × 92.5 × 76.5 inches, with an 8 kW, 240 V heater.
paragraphs: Barrel 8 covers the same 72.75 × 92.5 inches as Redwood's six-person Barrel with Porch. Here the length goes to seating, and the rating rises to eight people. It is made from Canadian Thermowood and stands 76.5 inches high.

The heater also moves up to 8 kW and 40 amps at 240 volts. If your panel can only spare 30 amps, stay with a six-person model. The barrel weighs 1,150 pounds and is listed with a 44 × 96 × 33-inch crate.
decision_points: 8 kW and 40 amps, compared with 6 kW and 30 for the six-person barrels.
Same height as Barrel 6.
No porch at this size.
limitations: Redwood doesn't give bench length, interior size or the required circuit for the Barrel 8.

entries.heading: Black-stained Hemlock for eight
entries.summary: Redwood Outdoors Noctra 8 is an 8-person outdoor sauna in black-stained Hemlock, 75.5 × 89.75 × 85.75 inches, with an 8 kW heater at 240 V and 40 A.
paragraphs: Noctra stands out by color, with heat-treated Hemlock stained black. The eight-person outdoor sauna is 75.5 × 89.75 inches on the ground and 85.75 inches high. That makes it 15 inches narrower than Garden, which also seats eight.
It has an 8 kW heater rated for 40 amps at 240 volts, like Garden and Barrel 8. At 1,410 pounds and with a 90.5 × 50.5 × 32.25-inch crate, ask the carrier how far it will bring it.
decision_points: The heaviest Redwood sauna with a published weight here.
9 inches taller than Barrel 8, at nearly the same length.
Ask how often the black stain needs recoating.
limitations: Redwood doesn't publish the Noctra's interior dimensions, required circuit or stain care interval.

entries.heading: Infrared and traditional heat for five
entries.summary: Finnleo IS565 InfraSauna is a 5-person indoor hybrid sauna in Hemlock, 73.75 × 61.75 × 80 inches, with infrared and traditional heat on 240 V, 30 A.
paragraphs: IS565 combines infrared with a traditional heater in one indoor cabin. Five people are listed for 73.75 × 61.75 inches, with a height of 80 inches. Hemlock is used inside and out. That is 2 inches wider than the traditional NorthStar 4 × 6 and almost 14 inches deeper.

Finnleo lists 6 kW at 240 volts on a 30-amp breaker, hardwired. Having two kinds of heat on that one supply makes it worth asking how they work together. The manual and control package will have the answer.
decision_points: Finnleo also makes the two-person IS440 InfraSauna, 48.25 inches square.
80 inches tall, 4 inches lower than the NorthStar cabins.
Hardwired 30 amps, 240 volts.
limitations: Finnleo's details don't say whether both heat modes can run at once.
Interior size and wall clearances for the IS565 are missing.

entries.heading: Four feet deep, seats two
entries.summary: Finnleo NorthStar 4 × 6 is a 2-person indoor traditional sauna, 72 × 48 × 84 inches in Nordic White Spruce, with a 4.5 kW heater on 240 V, 30 A.
paragraphs: The name gives the size in feet, 4 deep and 6 wide. In inches that is 72 × 48, with a height of 84. Finnleo lists two seats, Nordic White Spruce walls inside and out, and benches and backrests in clear Abachi or Aspen.
NorthStar 4 × 6 has a 4.5 kW heater on 240 volts. Finnleo gives 30 amps for it, the same as for the 6 kW heaters in the larger NorthStars, so going smaller doesn't necessarily save on wiring.
decision_points: A foot shallower than the 5 × 6 and 5 × 7.
7 feet tall, which rules out some basements.
If you want to lie down, ask for the bench length.
limitations: Finnleo doesn't state interior dimensions, circuit size or connection for the 4 × 6.

entries.heading: One foot deeper, 6 kW heater
entries.summary: Finnleo NorthStar 5 × 6 is an indoor traditional sauna listed for 2 people, 72 × 60 × 84 inches, with a 6 kW heater at 240 V and 30 A.
paragraphs: NorthStar 5 × 6 adds 12 inches of depth to the 4 × 6 and keeps its 72-inch width and 84-inch height. Finnleo's capacity field says two people, although its own description says the cabin seats three. Walls are Nordic White Spruce, benches clear Aspen or Abachi.
The heater goes up from 4.5 to 6 kW on 240 volts while the current stays at 30 amps. If the deeper floor plan fits, the electrical side looks the same on paper.
decision_points: Choose it over the 4 × 6 for bench depth and 1.5 kW more heater.
Treat it as a two-person sauna and ask about a third seat.
60 inches deep, 84 inches high.
limitations: Finnleo contradicts itself on seats for the 5 × 6, two in one place and three in another.
No interior dimensions are given.

entries.heading: Seven feet wide, four to five seats
entries.summary: Finnleo NorthStar 5 × 7 is a 4-5 person indoor traditional sauna, 84 × 60 × 84 inches in Nordic White Spruce, with a 6 kW heater at 240 V, 30 A.
paragraphs: One more foot of width turns NorthStar from a two-seater into what Finnleo calls a four-to-five-person sauna. The 5 × 7 is 84 inches wide, 60 deep and 84 high. Its walls are Nordic White Spruce, with clear Abachi or Aspen benches and backrests.
Power is unchanged from the 5 × 6, with 6 kW at 240 volts and 30 amps. For a group of five, ask Finnleo how the benches are laid out and whether a larger heater is offered.
decision_points: 12 inches wider than the 5 × 6 on the same circuit figure.
Needs a 7-foot wall and a 7-foot ceiling, plus working room.
Four to five is Finnleo's range, so plan around four if in doubt.
limitations: Finnleo doesn't give bench lengths, clearances or the breaker size for the 5 × 7.

entries.heading: Small footprint, over 8 feet tall
entries.summary: SunRay Bristow is a 2-person outdoor traditional sauna in Canadian Hemlock, 50 × 50 × 98 inches, with a hardwired 4.5 kW Harvia on 220 V, 30 A.
paragraphs: On the ground Bristow needs just 50 × 50 inches. It is also 98 inches tall, so the metal roof comes up above 8 feet. Two people share a 45 × 45-inch interior that is 73 inches high, in Canadian Hemlock.
A 4.5 kW Harvia heater is included and has to be hardwired on its own 220-volt, 30-amp circuit. Chromotherapy lighting and Bluetooth speakers are part of the package too.
decision_points: Check overhangs and covered patios against 98 inches.
25 inches of the height is outside the room.
Heater, lights and speakers come with it.
limitations: SunRay doesn't state foundation needs, weight or clearances for the Bristow.

entries.heading: Cedar barrel with floor and roof included
entries.summary: SunRay Aurora is a 2-4 person red cedar barrel sauna, 72 × 61 × 76 inches, with a hardwired 6 kW Harvia heater on a 220 V, 30 A circuit.
paragraphs: Aurora is a Western Red Cedar barrel for two to four people. The outside is 72 × 61 × 76 inches and the inside 69 × 51 × 69. SunRay includes a flat floor kit and a shingled roof, plus stainless-steel hardware and tempered glass. You can set it up inside or outside.
The 6 kW Harvia comes with stones and is hardwired to a dedicated 30-amp circuit at 220 volts. Outdoors, add a level base to the budget. Indoors, work out where the moisture goes.
decision_points: 11 inches deeper than the square Bristow, and 22 inches lower.
Floor and roof are in the kit.
1.5 kW more heater than Bristow on the same 30 amps.
limitations: SunRay doesn't publish weight, package size or clearances for the Aurora.

entries.heading: Measure your doors for the front wall
entries.summary: Salus Ally is a 2-person indoor traditional sauna in cedar, 60 × 46 × 83 inches, with a hardwired 6 kW Harvia KIP heater on 240 V and 30 A.
paragraphs: Ally's front wall arrives in one piece, 59.1 inches wide and 78 inches high, and Salus says it can't be taken apart. Walk the route from the curb with those numbers before anything else. Assembled, the two-person sauna is 60 × 46 × 83 inches, with 56 × 38 × 78 inches inside.

Outside is Pacific Clear Cedar, the benches are Red Cedar, and the front and door are tempered glass. A Harvia KIP 6 kW heater is included and needs a hardwired 220/240-volt, 30-amp connection. The touchscreen control has FM radio and Bluetooth.
decision_points: A tight stairwell can rule it out even if the room is big enough.
Hire an electrician for the 30-amp line.
Salus lists it as unavailable, so ask about stock first.
limitations: Salus doesn't say if the Ally's circuit must be dedicated, and lists no clearances.

entries.heading: Roof extends well past the base
entries.summary: Tylo Lulea 4 is a 3-4 person outdoor traditional sauna in clear Hemlock with an 86 × 61-inch base, 94 inches tall, and an 8 kW heater at 240 V, 35 A.
paragraphs: Two sets of numbers matter for Lulea 4. The foundation is 86 × 61 inches, but the roof measures 85 × 102 inches and reaches out past it. Plan your distance to the fence or house from the roof. The cabin stands 94 inches tall, is made of clear Hemlock with tinted tempered glass, and seats three to four.
A Sense Bliss 8 heater comes with it, 8 kW on 240 volts with a 35-amp circuit. Bliss controls with the Tylo app and chromotherapy lighting are included. The Bluetooth sound bar is optional.
decision_points: Use 102 inches as the width when you measure the site.
35 amps is an unusual size, so check the breaker choice with the electrician.
App control is part of the package.
limitations: Tylo doesn't state the interior dimensions, the connection method or wall clearances for the Lulea 4.

entries.heading: Infrared on Hekla costs extra
entries.summary: GeyserSteam Hekla is a 2-3 person traditional sauna for indoors or outdoors, 57 × 55 × 83 inches in Thermowood, with a 6 kW heater at 220 V, 30 A.
paragraphs: Hekla's product title mentions traditional and infrared heat. What you get in the base price is a Finnish-style dry sauna with a 6 kW lava-rock heater; infrared panels and red light are add-ons. It seats two to three on two bench levels and measures 57 × 55 × 83 inches.

The heater needs 30 amps at 220 volts. GeyserSteam doesn't say how it connects, and the infrared option needs power on top of that. Decide about add-ons before the electrician starts, so the line only gets run once.
decision_points: Compare the price without infrared first.
Scandinavian Thermowood, tempered glass and an aluminum frame.
The smallest GeyserSteam cabin here.
limitations: GeyserSteam doesn't state the interior size or how much power Hekla's add-ons draw.

entries.heading: A 13.5 kW heater on 65 amps
entries.summary: GeyserSteam Lukaku is a 6-8 person traditional sauna for indoors or outdoors, 86 × 87 × 86 inches, with a 13.5 kW heater at 240 V and 65 A.
paragraphs: Lukaku is close to a cube, 86 × 87 inches on the floor and 86 inches high. GeyserSteam rates it for six to eight people on two-level benches. Thermowood and tempered glass make up the cabin, and LED lighting is included. Infrared is available as an add-on.

The figure to check first is 65 amps. The 13.5 kW Vevor heater runs on 240 volts and takes 25 amps more than Valera, and plenty of home panels can't spare that. Talk to an electrician before you order.
decision_points: Get the panel looked at before ordering.
Balerion has the same outside dimensions and needs 30 amps.
Valera is 27 inches shallower and runs on 40 amps.
limitations: GeyserSteam doesn't publish Lukaku's interior dimensions, connection method or clearances.

entries.heading: Five feet deep with a 9 kW heater
entries.summary: GeyserSteam Valera is a 4-5 person traditional sauna for indoors or outdoors, 86 × 60 × 86 inches, with a 9 kW heater at 220 V and 40 A.
paragraphs: Valera has the width and height of Lukaku, 86 inches each, but only 60 inches of depth. GeyserSteam lists four to five seats. The cabin is Thermowood and tempered glass, and a floor kit and LED lighting come with it.
A 9 kW Vevor heater at 220 volts needs 40 amps, which is a lot easier to find in a panel than Lukaku's 65. Infrared and red light are optional and would add to the load.
decision_points: Fits where Lukaku is too deep.
Price the infrared and red-light options with their wiring.
40 amps instead of 65.
limitations: GeyserSteam doesn't say how Valera's heater connects and gives no interior dimensions.

entries.heading: Large infrared cabin on 30 amps
entries.summary: GeyserSteam Balerion is a 6-8 person full-spectrum infrared sauna for indoors or outdoors, 86 × 87 × 86 inches, with 5 kW at 240 V and 30 A.
paragraphs: Balerion is the infrared option at Lukaku's size, 86 × 87 × 86 inches for six to eight people. Full-spectrum panels and rods are included, along with two-level benches, LED lighting and ventilation openings. The cabin is made of Thermowood and tempered glass and can stand indoors or outdoors.
GeyserSteam lists 5,000 watts on 240 volts with a 30-amp breaker. Lukaku needs 65 amps for its 13.5 kW heater, so Balerion is far easier on the panel if you're happy with infrared.
decision_points: Less than half the current of Lukaku.
No traditional heater is included.
The product page's web address shows a different name; the specs are Balerion's.
limitations: GeyserSteam doesn't publish Balerion's interior dimensions, delivery size or connection method.
